decisions.reason: As a chair family tightly aligned with the firm's core premium furnishing range, it is likely to meet or stay close enough to aspiration levels to justify retention.

After several years, these more peripheral floor cushions would face tougher comparison with aspiration levels, and if still niche the firm would likely reallocate resources to stronger core lines or new development.
The sofa remains close to the firm's established lounge and living offer, so available capabilities and portfolio logic make continued retention slightly more likely than withdrawal.

Even though rugs are more distant from the legacy offer, this collection fits the firm's stated strategic direction and flagship status, which raises management's willingness to tolerate uncertainty and keep it.
